NPEC CV Documentation
=====================

**NPEC CV** is a computer vision pipeline for automated plant root detection,
segmentation, and morphological measurement. It combines deep learning
(TensorFlow / Keras) with classical image processing to deliver precise
root phenotyping from microscopy images.
